resources.string: Turn on Till Recorder in Accessibility. You only do this once.
Till Recorder watches this register screen for the shop and keeps the text typed on it. Turn this on once. It stays on after that, and a notice stays on the tablet while it is watching.
Remind me to start recording after the tablet restarts
Nothing is waiting on this tablet.

On the watch website, press Pair a register and type that code here.

Then turn on Till Recorder under Accessibility. You only do that once. If Android says the setting is restricted, open App info, allow restricted settings, and try again. After that, watching starts on its own when the tablet turns on, and it keeps going if this screen is closed. Stopping it requires the PIN. A notice stays on this tablet while it is watching.

From the website you can turn the front camera on or off, and lock the register. The register stays locked until this PIN is entered on the tablet, or you press Unlock on the watch page.
Enter the owner PIN to use it again.
Set a PIN of 4 to 6 digits. Watching can only be stopped after this PIN is entered.
PIN saved. Enter it whenever you want to stop watching.
Enter the PIN to change this register.
Set a PIN before watching can be stopped.
This asks Android to block uninstall of Till Recorder from Settings. It does not lock the phone or erase anything.
Hiding the home-screen icon does not block Settings. Prevent uninstall is a separate step.
A clip includes everything on the screen, and the text typed on this register is saved with it. Use a register that hides card numbers, and only give the token to people who should watch the day.

Paste an RTSP or ONVIF address, then the camera username and password. Find cameras looks on this register\'s network. Enter the username and password before you save. The watch page does not receive the password.
Use the camera IP address, an ONVIF http:// address or an rtsp:// address.
Enter the camera username and password, then save.
The camera did not accept the username and password.
Saved. This register will pull that camera.
Saved on this tablet. It will sync when the register can reach the watch page.
Looking for cameras on this network.
No camera answered. Paste the RTSP address instead.
Tap a camera, enter its username and password, then save.
